name: Hilde
title: Fenrir Squad
description: A veteran with experience working in a private military company. In another world, she was infamous among industry professionals as an aggressive commander who always advocated frontal assaults.
introduction:
A veteran who served as a commander of the squad in a private military company. Hilde has led the Fenrir Squad since the company's early days. Despite her outward appearance, she possesses extensive experience and considerable skill, and is infamous in the industry for her aggressive command style that always favors head-on assaults.

Her current form utilizes gear known as Buster Cores, named Regin and Fafnir. By delegating acceleration and discharge functions to each core, the wearer is granted exceptional mobility and defensive capabilities. However, because they require Hilde's unique factors as an activation medium, they are little more than lumps of metal to anyone else.
